::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">then what</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Before you come</h2>

::: {.csf-steps}
- ### Tell us about food
  Allergies, vegetarian, vegan, anything you can't eat. It changes what gets bought, so
  say it when you sign up, not on the night.

- ### Don't cook anything
  Worth repeating: this isn't a potluck. The shopping is done and everything is on the
  table when you arrive.

- ### Bring a container, if you like
  Only for leftovers. There usually are some, and they're usually the best part of the
  next morning.

- ### Come roughly on time
  The first half hour is when we start the recipe and say hello. It's easier to arrive
  with everyone than into a full room.
:::
:::

::: {.csf-quote}
Come for the cake. **Stay for the people.**
:::

## One message and you're in

No forms, no fee, nothing to carry, and no need to know anybody already there.
